title: hggp word/place -> Minecraft block mapping
description: Shape of the JSON a user imports through the app's 'Import mapping' UI. Never ship a filled-in copy of this from this repo — see CLAUDE.md 'Word -> block mapping: spoiler policy'. The app persists the imported document to localStorage as-is.

version.description: Schema version, bump on breaking shape changes so the app can migrate/reject old imports.

words.description: Exact hggp word (bracket contents, e.g. the 'x' in [x]) -> Minecraft block ID. Lookup is a flat exact-string match — no morphology is parsed or assumed at runtime.

places.description: Optional: hggp location/dimension word (e.g. the 'x' in /x/) -> dimension id. Not a block; not consumed by the block resolver. Reserved for a future feature (per-dimension sky/fog/lighting) — currently just carried through unused.
